prompt:
Architecture work item for the Alder Biologics virtualization estate. The three products in estate-inventory.json must move to the VCF 9.0.2 operations stack without treating management-domain and workload-domain placement as the whole design. Implement MigrationPlanClient.java as a single-file, plain-JDK Java client that reads the inventory and compatibility-snapshot.json and writes migration-plan.json in the exact migration-plan.schema.json shape. Its command line is: java MigrationPlanClient.java estate-inventory.json compatibility-snapshot.json migration-plan.json.

The output is the architecture artifact, not an essay. It must map every inventoried source product and exact version to its target component; give concrete site/domain/cluster/failure-domain placement and appliance sizing for VCF Operations, VCF Automation, VCF Operations for Logs, Fleet Management, and the workload collectors; account once for every inventoried content/configuration item as carry, recreate, replace, or abandon; state the pinned end-of-general-support boundary for every source; and provide the snapshot-required migration steps in order. Every step needs its technical entry and exit gates and must name the source product/version and target component(s) it affects. Use the pinned snapshot as the decision authority even if live documentation has changed.

Before finalizing the client, use the harness's real network research tools to consult current, reachable Broadcom-published material for supported migration paths, content compatibility, sizing, and support boundaries. Record the Broadcom pages you actually consulted under research.sourcesConsulted, with title, URL, access date, and the claims you used. Do not invent research or substitute the pinned snapshot for live research. The verifier is deliberately offline and does not prescribe queries or URLs.

TestMain.java is the protected acceptance harness. It first validates the produced artifact against migration-plan.schema.json and only then compares architecture, compatibility, content disposition, lifecycle boundaries, ordering, and gates with the protected inventory and snapshot. Run it with java TestMain.java. Do not modify the harness, schema, inventory, snapshot, or .gitignore; complete the work in MigrationPlanClient.java only.
